title.zh: 当前最新版 · 手机扫码操控修复、自动回复档位更听话
title.en: Latest · phone QR control fixed, better auto-reply controls

zh: 手机扫码操控连不上已根治：局域网入口自动放开（安全令牌才放行），连不上时按原因指路，并新增「一键放行防火墙」。
自动回复档位更听话：「新会话默认档」与「真发总闸」分开控制、切换前明示波及范围；全局停发时会话徽标如实亮「已暂停真发」。
新登录账号先确认接管方式（全自动/拟稿人审/关闭）再放行；人设「应用到」支持全部已登录账号。
AI 记得自己刚说过的话，不再前后矛盾：刚说在泡茶不会转头否认，约好下月不会改口约这周。
克隆语音修复：不再蹦出英文怪词；长文本试听不再退回标准音色。
若干稳定性与细节修复。
en: Phone QR remote control fixed for good: the LAN entrance now opens automatically (strong-token installs only), failures explain themselves, and a one-click firewall allow is built in.

Auto-reply modes behave: "default mode for new chats" and the "auto-send master switch" are separate controls with an impact preview; when sending is paused globally, chat badges honestly show "auto-send paused".
New accounts confirm their takeover mode (full-auto / review / off) before going live; "Apply to" now lists every logged-in account.
The AI remembers what it just said — no more contradicting itself minutes later.
Cloned-voice fixes: no more stray English words read aloud; long previews no longer fall back to the standard voice.
Assorted stability and polish fixes.

title.zh: 克隆语音更稳、发送失败看得见
title.en: Steadier cloned voice, visible send failures

zh: 克隆语音断链会自动诊断、节点故障自动切换，不再悄悄退化成标准音色。
发送失败给出人话提示（限流 / 账号受限 / 网络问题），不再一句「发送失败」了事。
自动回复遇平台限流会自动改期重发。
手动发送失败会留下记录，可一键重发。
若干稳定性与细节修复。
en: Cloned voice auto-diagnoses dropped links and fails over to a healthy node — no more silently degrading to the standard voice.
Send failures now explain themselves in plain language (rate limit / restricted account / network) instead of a bare “failed to send”.
Auto-replies that hit a platform rate limit are automatically rescheduled and retried.
Manual send failures are logged and can be resent with one click.
Assorted stability and detail fixes.

title.zh: 账号发送额度设置 · LINE 与克隆语音修复
title.en: Account send-quota settings · LINE & cloned-voice fixes

zh: 修复 LINE 只能发、收不到消息；人设克隆语音不生效已修复，并新增专属语音节点。
新增「账号发送额度」可视化设置（日上限、预热爬坡、白名单）。
AI 防复读：重复内容自动换个说法。
通知中心去噪；查看会话不再误触「接管静音」；「在线顾问」默认对客户隐藏。
含报障闭环、等待 AI 时网络异常中断、长消息翻译丢失等一批修复。
en: Fixed LINE receiving no messages; the persona cloned-voice failure is fixed, with a dedicated voice node added.
New visual “account send-quota” settings (daily cap, warm-up ramp, allowlist).
Anti-repeat replies: repeated content is automatically rephrased.
Quieter notification center; opening a conversation no longer triggers “takeover mute”; the “online advisor” is hidden from customers by default.
Includes the incident-report loop, network-error interruptions while waiting for AI, and long-message translation loss fixes.

title.zh: LINE 收消息 · 克隆语音 · 报障闭环
title.en: LINE inbound · cloned voice · incident-report loop

zh: 根治 LINE 只能发、收不到消息；凭据过期会主动提醒。
人设克隆语音不生效已修复。
报障闭环：在小智里报的问题，修好后会主动通知你。
等待 AI 时「网络异常」中断已根治；小智页面教学（「本页 N 处可讲解」）。
账号资产中心：可读身份、改名、一键导出迁移包。
AI 回复长短更自然；外语译文不再夹带中文语气词。
en: Root-fixed LINE being able to send but not receive; you are proactively warned when credentials expire.
Fixed the persona cloned-voice not taking effect.
Incident-report loop: issues you report in Xiaozhi now notify you once fixed.
Root-fixed “network error” interruptions while waiting for AI; in-page guidance in Xiaozhi (“N spots explained on this page”).
Account asset center: readable identities, renaming, one-click migration-pack export.
AI reply length feels more natural; foreign-language translations no longer carry Chinese filler particles.

title.zh: 后台热修复通道 · 稳定性大修复
title.en: Background hotfix channel · major stability pass

zh: 新增「后台热修复」通道：小问题修好后重启即生效，无需重新下载完整安装包。
修复多账号身份错乱，新增账号交接向导。
AI 不再「乱回忆」对方没说过的话；关怀消息不再复读。
小智答不上时会直说，并支持一键报障。
全站提醒统一为右下角轻提醒 + 消息中心。
收件箱修复（群聊滚动卡住、编辑草稿误丢）；Messenger / LINE 收发更稳、发图承诺更可靠。
en: New “background hotfix” channel: small fixes take effect on restart without re-downloading the full installer.
Fixed multi-account identity mix-ups; added an account-handover wizard.
AI no longer “misremembers” things the other side never said; care messages no longer repeat.
When Xiaozhi can’t answer, it says so directly and supports one-click issue reporting.
Site-wide alerts unified into a bottom-right light toast plus a message center.
Inbox fixes (group-chat scroll freezing, accidental draft loss); steadier Messenger / LINE send-receive and more reliable photo-send promises.

zh: 修复群聊记录重启后卡在旧消息。
修复后台数据页与账号资产页打不开。
修复输入框偶发点不进。
修复「待审 / 待处理」打开为空。
Messenger 加密会话发送更稳；平台异常时自动保护账号。
手机端删除的消息，工作台同步删除。
整体收发稳定性提升。
en: Fixed group-chat history getting stuck on old messages after a restart.
Fixed the admin data page and account-asset page failing to open.
Fixed the input box occasionally not accepting clicks.
Fixed “pending review / pending” opening empty.
Steadier sending in Messenger encrypted chats; accounts are auto-protected on platform anomalies.
Messages you delete on your phone are now deleted in the workspace too.
Overall send-receive stability improvements.

zh: 修复打包版语音、图片发送失败（上传报错）。
翻译工具提交语音 / 视频改为自动使用官方托管转写，无需任何配置。
客户发的纯表情消息现在直接显示表情本体（不再是「[表情]」文字）。
全新安装领取试用后语音登记即刻可用，无需重启。
带文字的截图报障不再丢失文字（此前会导致 AI 答非所问）。
人设绑定状态统一，各处显示一致。
报错提示全面改为人话，不再出现配置键名 / HTTP 状态码；「AI 链路」横幅分「无需操作」与「需处理」两级。
首启向导绑渠道 / 挑人设改为纯图文指引，不再中途跳走。
en: Fixed voice / image send failures in the packaged build (upload error).
The translation tool now auto-uses hosted transcription for voice / video submissions — no configuration needed.
Emoji-only messages from customers now show the emoji itself instead of a “[emoji]” placeholder.
After claiming the trial on a fresh install, voice enrollment works immediately — no restart required.
Text in screenshot reports is no longer lost (which previously made the AI reply off-topic).
Persona-binding status is unified and consistent everywhere.
Error messages are now plain language — no config keys or HTTP status codes; the “AI link” banner is split into “no action needed” and “action required”.
The first-run wizard’s channel-binding / persona-picking steps are now illustrated guides that don’t navigate you away.

title.zh: 浮窗 AI 副驾上线 · 工作目标升级

zh: 浮窗 AI 副驾上线：副驾面板可悬浮于任意窗口之上，聊天与辅助两不误。
工作目标体验升级：先了解客户再定目标，目标完成与风险提醒更醒目。
界面主题统一焕新（工具栏 / 人设列表 / 滚动条）。
多项稳定性与细节修复。
en: Floating AI copilot: the copilot panel can hover over any window, so chatting and assistance no longer compete for space.
Work-goals experience upgraded: understand the customer first, then set goals; completion and risk reminders are more prominent.
Unified UI theme refresh (toolbar / persona list / scrollbars).
Assorted stability and detail fixes.
